title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT04999999: Phase 1 NX-14 in hepatic fibrosis (terminated)
body: Phase 1 trial of NX-14 in patients with biopsy-proven hepatic fibrosis. Status: Terminated - safety signal detected. 12 patients enrolled, 3 developed elevated liver enzymes (AST >500 U/L) and 1 patient hospitalized for acute hepatotoxicity. Trial halted after interim safety review. This trial suggests potential ROCK2-inhibition-related hepatotoxicity in a different fibrotic indication. Trial registry has not been updated since 2020.
